units.source_text: “实在想不通……算了吧，反正，人生嘛，也不是凭着‘能想通’活下去的……

en.t: I really cannot make sense of it... Oh well, never mind. After all, life is not something you live by being able to make sense of it...

units.source_text: 可是，还有‘那种生活’，‘这种生活’，那些人的日子看起来似乎还马马虎虎……

en.t: But then there is that sort of life, this sort of life, and those people seem to be getting by well enough...

units.source_text: 就这样生活下去，想到将来会变得如何，那是最忍受不了的……

en.t: Going on living like this, and thinking about what the future might become, that is what I find hardest to bear...

units.source_text: 无论怎样的生活，将来的事肯定谁都不知道呀……

en.t: Whatever kind of life it is, surely no one knows what the future will bring...

units.source_text: 算啦，我总觉得，哪怕只有一点儿，也还是糊涂一点的好呵……”

en.t: Never mind. I always feel that, even if only a little, it is still better to be somewhat muddled...
